dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged light-colored closed-loop perimeters ('O' shapes) and semi-closed 'C' shapes with sharp gradient transitions from a bright outer boundary to a darker interior matching the base pelt color.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid light-intensity pixel clusters concentrated on the anterior-dorsal neck region and along the lower lateral-ventral transition, lacking internal dark gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form an irregular trapezoid; a secondary group of three smaller annuli on the mid-lateral flank forms an obtuse triangular relationship.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized cluster of high-intensity red and white pixels is visible on the lower posterior-lateral flank, indicative of an active lesion or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced front flipper with five distinct high-contrast vertical serrations corresponding to distal claw structures.
